usedFor: Cardly holds card orders and gifts, and Google Drive opens a file by link through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Automation Order Sent” in Cardly, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Once a card is dispatched, the action sets a link and a Viewer, Commenter or Editor level.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive opens a file to anyone with the link, so choose access carefully.
